evidence.title: marutto pixel — free pixel art materials

name: marutto pixel
summary: Free library of 182 16px pixel art materials with a canvas editor to mix, recolor and export PNG, SVG, GIF or MP4.
description: A free pixel art playground: browse 16x16 materials (animals, foods, nature, vegetables, fruits, home, accessories), drag them onto a canvas to flip, scale and recolor, then download the result as transparent PNG at x1, x2, x4 or x8, SVG, a 3D-style image, an animated GIF or an MP4. Public community mixes can be browsed and remixed; commercial use is allowed without credit.
